questions.q: A runner heads for the right channel. Tap where the right midfielder should recover.
options: Step up in front of the runner
Alongside the runner, nearer our goal
questions.explain: Yes. Alongside and nearer our goal, you can see the runner and still protect the goal.
choiceExplanations: That leaves the runner alone behind our midfield, free to receive.
The runner is already behind you, so stepping up leaves them free.
Yes. Alongside and nearer our goal, you can see the runner and still protect the goal.

questions.q: Put the runner hand-off in order, from first to last.
options: Center defender calls and takes over
questions.explain: Yes. See the run, recover with it, then share the job only after the call.
choiceExplanations: Yes. See the run, recover with it, then share the job only after the call.
We recover because the runner moved, so the run comes first.
The runner checks inside after we have recovered with them.
The center defender takes over last, once the runner comes near them.

questions.q: True or false? With the center defender far away, the midfielder can leave the runner.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. No teammate is close and ready, so keep tracking the runner.
choiceExplanations: The center defender is too far to take over, so the runner would be left alone.
Right, it's false. No teammate is close and ready, so keep tracking the runner.
